decision_conditions:
﻿Obscured Glazing - Before the development hereby permitted is first occupied, the upper floor windows inserted into the side elevation shall be glazed with obscured glass and shall be maintained as such thereafter.

Reason:  To safeguard the amenities and privacy of the occupiers of adjoining properties and to comply with the following Development Plan policies for Merton: policies D3 and D4 of the London Plan 2021 and policies D12.3 & D12.4 of the Local Plan 2024.
description:
APPLICATION FOR THE ERECTION OF A SINGLE STOREY REAR
